scenarios.title: Slow start, then it catches on
scenarios.blurb: From 2 tippers a day to about 30 by the end.

scenarios.title: Hype, then it fades
scenarios.blurb: 30 tippers on day one, halving about every 8 days.

scenarios.title: Quiet weekends
scenarios.blurb: 14 tippers on weekdays, 2 on Saturday and Sunday.

scenarios.title: One loud self-promoter
scenarios.blurb: The steady flock, plus one account that buys the squawk for its own post every day.

scenarios.title: Last-minute sniper
scenarios.blurb: The same self-promoter, feeding in the final minute of each round.

scenarios.title: Sybil swarm
scenarios.blurb: The steady flock, tip for tip, but every tip is split across up to 10 accounts.

scenarios.title: Ghost town
scenarios.blurb: A tip every two or three days, and nobody waking Polly on time.
